Blaze | Sem-Lore Spokesperson 3/27/2022 9:47 PM
The rules of the Politics card aren't too difficult but it's important to note. You get to assign the speaker token to anyone who does not already have the speaker token This means that if you take the Politics card while you already have the speaker token, the best deal you could make for yourself going into the following round is passing Speaker one step to the left... so if we passed it to Naaz-Rokha, for instance. However, how often does this matter? Well, it's always a factor but the real kicker is when you are going into round 5. If we had passed Speaker to Naaz-Rokha round 3, that would mean that round 4 we got the best case scenario for round 4 really, second pick, not bad. But also not round 5 It's not entirely impossible that Naaz-Rokha would've then picked Politics themselves, passing the speaker token farter to the left... not ideal not that 3rd pick is the end of the world round 5 What we effectively did instead is we sacrificed round 4's pick order and ended up with last pick. Xxcha then has the decision of picking politics, and again, they cannot give themselves speaker, so it would have to go to us which is BIG PROFIT Xxcha's other alternative is simply not picking Politics, but Speaker unfortunately matters so much round 5 that this is basically death
BigAlCupAChino 3/27/2022 9:50 PM
Leadership and Imperial are the two most important cards. Leadership gets you to score first in final round for the win. Imperial gives you a tempo boost. Politics gives you speaker which gives you the card you need (normally leadership or imperial). Speaker management is making sure you are speaker when you need it which is normally the last round. In base game the environment was less rich, less frags, explores, frontiers, etc so players NEEDED the primary of cards like construction or tech to keep scoring tempo. Speaker manipulation came at a cost. In POK things are faster with more resources and avenues so speaker management becomes more pronounced. That said its kind of like Nekro and Hacan both having QDN, a bit cat and mouse.
Davey 3/27/2022 9:50 PM
